info.name: Ride-Hailing Dispatch (kvp)
info.description:
Scenarios for Coding Challenge #3. Start the stack first (`make up` in coding-challenge-3/kvp).

* Run the whole collection with the **Runner** (keep the order), or one folder at a time.
* Every folder is self-contained: its first request picks a random spot on the map and creates its own drivers through the driver-service fixture API (`{{driverServiceUrl}}/internal/drivers/...`), so folders never interfere.
* Dispatch is asynchronous. Requests that check the result first wait (pre-request script, max 10–45 s) until the expected state is reached.
* Variables: `baseUrl` (gateway, default http://localhost:8080) and `driverServiceUrl` (http://localhost:8082).
